DeployBot: [deploybot] Release candidate rc-2026.03.14 flagged: SBOM mismatch for artifact 'inference-runtime:2026.03.14' and a new low-severity transitive vuln CVE-2026-1451 found in libfastjson. Blocking canary deploy until triage.
Ravi: Ping @Ava @Jamal - do we pin, hotpatch, or rollback? EU canary about to start in 10m.
Ava: Can we get quick repro and SBOM diff? If vuln is transitive and low-sev maybe timebox pin with monitoring. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
DeployBot: SBOM diff attached: added dependency path -> libfastjson 1.2.3 (no PGP signature). Vulnerability source: vulnscan v0.9.18, severity LOW, exploitability LOW.
Jamal: If no exploitability and it's transitive from a test-only dep, I'd prefer staged pin+canary in NA and hold EU. Rollback is heavy.
Marta: We need to update release notes and callout the temporary pin if we go that route. Also legal check for license is pending.
LegalBot: License check shows libfastjson is MIT, no blockers. Still want provenance signed artifact for EU regs. Requesting evidence of build provenance.
QA-Tony: Ran smoke on rc-2026.03.14 -- metrics: ok, 2 flaky tests unrelated. No functional regression observed. Logs below:
```
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z ERROR cache miss for model shard 3
2026-03-14T09:12:04Z WARN fallback to cpu kernel
```
Ravi: Option A: pin dependency to libfastjson 1.2.2 (previous) and push quick rebuild; Option B: allow NA canary with extra monitoring, block EU. Thoughts?
Ava: I can build and push a pinned image in ~12m. We should also add rollout-wide alert for error spikes and latency increases.
Jamal: +1 to pin-and-rebuild. Avoid full rollback. Who'll approve the change window exception for EU?
Marta: I'll log the release notes patch and notify comms. Approver needed: @Ravi or eng-release oncall.
Ravi: I approve pin-and-rebuild for canary NA. EU remains blocked until signed provenance is attached or 24h pass. @DeployBot can you start pinned-build pipeline on my signal?
DeployBot: Received approval. To start pinned build run: `./ci/rebuild --image inference-runtime --pin libfastjson=1.2.2 --tag rc-2026.03.14-pinned` Once build finishes it will trigger canary in us-west.
LegalBot: Noted. Will verify provenance when new image is available.
QA-Tony: I'll run extended canary tests post-build and post-monitoring alerts.
Ravi: OK we're doing pinned rebuild. EU block stays. Will update release notes and the change window. :white_check_mark:
Marta: Copy. I'll post a short note for product and support.
DeployBot: Pinned build pipeline started by user Ravi at 2026-03-14T09:25:00Z. Will report status here.
Ravi: Thanks everyone. If pinned build fails we roll back to previous stable release.
Jamal: Standing by to execute rollback if needed. :mechanical_arm:
